name: agenthub
description: Self-hosted mobile group chat where multiple AI members collaborate

AGENTHUB_TOKEN.description: The access token the App uses to connect (at least 16 characters). Make one with a password generator and paste the same value into the App.

AGENTHUB_SECRET.description: Encrypts the API keys stored on the server (at least 16 characters). **Back it up: if it is lost or changed, saved keys cannot be decrypted.**
